Burst Pipe: Turn off the stop tap (usually under the kitchen sink).
Switch off electrics if water is near sockets or fittings.
Open cold taps to drain the system.
Catch water with buckets and towels, then call us.
Toilet Overflow: Turn the isolation valve on the cistern pipe clockwise with a flat screwdriver.
Lift the float in the cistern to stop it filling.
Call us. We'll clear the blockage and check the waste pipe.
Water Leak: Find the nearest isolation valve, or turn off the stop tap.
Move valuables and rugs away from the water.
Call us to trace and fix the source.
No Hot Water: Check the boiler display for a fault code and note it.
Check the thermostat and timer settings.
Check the boiler pressure gauge (usually 1–1.5 bar).
Don't open the boiler casing. Call us.
Blocked Drain: Stop running taps and flushing toilets that feed the drain.
Don't use chemical unblockers on a full drain.
Keep children and pets away from overflowing manholes.
Call us for jetting and clearance.
Tap Won't Turn Off: Look for an isolation valve on the pipe under the tap.
Turn it a quarter-turn with a flat screwdriver.
If there isn't one, turn off the stop tap.
Call us to replace the washer or cartridge.
Ceiling Leak: Turn off the stop tap and the electrics to that area if safe.
Keep out from under a bulging ceiling.
Put a bucket underneath and move belongings.
Call us now before the ceiling fails.
